product_overview: SquashBa is a mobile-first PWA for the squash community in Bahia that combines player networking with tournament and match management. It lets users create profiles, connect with other players, run championships and challenges, and record match scores directly in the app.
core_goals: Create a usable player identity through signup and onboarding
Help players discover the community, profiles, and conversations
Allow organizers to create and manage championships
Let participants record and finalize match scores for their own matches
Support creation and management of challenges between players
Provide a directory of coaches, players, and marketplace listings
Give users access to their own matches, profile settings, help, and app updates

features.name: Authentication and account access
features.description: Users can sign in, create an account, request a password reset, or use a magic link to access the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the authenticated app
Navigate to /login -> Switch to sign-up mode -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the registration form -> See confirmation that the account was created
Navigate to /login -> Switch to forgot-password mode -> Enter email address -> Request a password reset -> See confirmation that the reset email was sent
Navigate to /login -> Switch to magic-link mode -> Enter email address -> Request a magic link -> See confirmation that the link was sent
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an invalid-credentials message

features.name: Password recovery
features.description: Users can set a new password after following a recovery link.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/update-password -> Enter a new password -> Confirm the new password -> Submit the update form -> See confirmation that the password was changed

features.name: Onboarding and profile setup
features.description: New authenticated users complete their first-run profile so they can use the app with a usable identity.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding -> Enter personal profile details -> Choose optional category and team -> Agree to the required consent terms -> Complete onboarding -> See the home screen
Navigate to /onboarding -> Enter personal profile details -> Enter a birth date indicating under 18 -> Provide guardian consent as required -> Complete onboarding -> See the home screen

features.name: Home feed and reminders
features.description: Users land on a personalized home screen that highlights current activity, reminders, rankings, and community highlights.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View welcome information and reminders -> See active matches and competitions -> See coaches and category rankings
Navigate to / -> Open a pending reminder -> See the related conversation, invite, or competition context

features.name: Championships management
features.description: Organizers can browse championships, create new ones, inspect details, edit them, and manage match scoring.
user_flows: Navigate to /campeonatos -> Browse the championships list -> Open the create championship flow -> Fill in championship details -> Submit the form -> See the new championship in the list
Navigate to /campeonatos -> Open a championship -> View participants and standings -> Review matches and standings
Navigate to /campeonatos/[id] -> Open a match -> Enter set scores -> Close the set when it is decided -> See the updated score and result

Navigate to /campeonatos/[id]/jogos/[matchId] -> Open the finish-match flow -> Choose a final-result option such as disqualification or interrupted match -> Confirm completion -> See the match finalized
Navigate to /campeonatos/[id]/jogos/[matchId] -> Open a finished match -> Reopen the match -> See the match return to an editable state

features.name: Challenges
features.description: Users can create challenges, view challenge details, and record results for challenge matches including walkovers.
user_flows: Navigate to /desafios -> Browse the challenge list -> Open the create challenge flow -> Fill in challenge details -> Submit the form -> See the new challenge in the list
Navigate to /desafios/[id] -> Review the challenge matches and status -> Open a match -> Enter scores -> Finalize the match -> See the result recorded
Navigate to /desafios/[id]/jogos/[matchId] -> Open the walkover flow -> Declare a W.O. -> Confirm the declaration -> See the winner recorded

features.name: Player matches
features.description: Players can review their scheduled and completed matches in one place.
user_flows: Navigate to /jogos -> View the list of own matches -> Open a match detail -> Review the match information

features.name: Community directory and player profiles
features.description: Users can browse players, open public profiles, and edit their own profile information.
user_flows: Navigate to /comunidade -> Browse the player directory -> Filter or search the list -> Open a player profile -> View the public profile details
Navigate to /jogador/[id] -> View a player's profile -> Start a direct conversation from the profile
Navigate to /perfil -> Open profile settings -> Edit personal information -> Save changes -> See the updated profile

features.name: Messaging
features.description: Players can view conversations and exchange direct messages.
user_flows: Navigate to /mensagens -> Open the conversations list -> Select a thread -> Read the conversation history
Navigate to /mensagens/[id] -> Open a conversation thread -> Compose a message -> Send the message -> See the new message in the thread

features.name: Marketplace listings
features.description: Users can browse coaches and service listings with contact details.
user_flows: Navigate to /marketplace -> Browse the listings -> Open a coach or service entry -> View contact details

features.name: Management hub
features.description: Organizers and admins can maintain shared categories, places, teams, announcements, and feedback records.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestao -> Open a management section -> Review the current records -> Update the shared catalog
Navigate to /gestao -> Open the announcements area -> Publish an announcement -> See it listed in the management area
Navigate to /gestao -> Open the feedback area -> Review submitted feedback -> Inspect the feedback details

features.name: Help, version, and privacy
features.description: Users can access help resources, submit feedback, view the app version history, and read the privacy policy.
user_flows: Navigate to /ajuda -> Review help content -> Submit feedback
Navigate to /versao -> View the app version and changelog information
Navigate to /privacidade -> Read the privacy policy

routes.description: Login, signup, magic link and password reset
Set a new password after a recovery link
Home feed (stories, hero match, activity feed)
Championship match detail and score entry
Challenge match detail and score entry
Admin/management hub (categories, places, teams, announcements, feedbacks)

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Email/password login, signup with email confirmation, magic link, and password reset via Supabase
user_interactions: Switch to signup or forgot-password mode
Request magic link with email only
See translated error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Championships
features.description: Create, view, edit championships, manage participants, view standings and record match scores
user_interactions: Open create championship form and submit
Open a championship to view participants and standings
Open a match and record set scores

features.name: Challenges
features.description: Create and manage 1v1/series challenges with match score entry and W.O. handling
user_interactions: Record match scores as a participant

features.name: Player Matches
features.description: View the current player's scheduled and completed matches

features.name: Community and Profiles
features.description: Browse the community of players and view public player profiles

features.name: Messaging
user_interactions: Open a thread and send a message

features.name: Management Hub
features.description: Organizer/admin management of categories, places, teams, announcements and feedbacks

known_limitations.issue: App requires Supabase authentication; valid test credentials are needed to reach any authenticated route
known_limitations.impact: Without credentials, only /login, /privacidade and auth pages are reachable

known_limitations.issue: Email confirmation is enabled for signup
known_limitations.impact: New signups cannot complete login until the confirmation email is clicked
